changes.after: He said to Dawid, You are more righteous than I; for you have rendered to me good, whereas I have rendered to you evil.

changes.before: Now the name of the person was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail; and the woman was of good understanding, and of a beautiful face: but the person was churlish and brokenness in their doings; and he was of the house of Kalev.
changes.after: Now the name of the person was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail; and the woman was of good understanding, and of a beautiful face: but the person was harsh and wrong in their conduct; and he was of the house of Kalev.

changes.before: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for brokenness is determined against our master, and against all his house: for he is such a worthless fellow that one can't speak to him.
changes.after: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for harm is planned against our master, and against all his house: for he is such a worthless fellow that one can't speak to him.

changes.before: Now Dawid had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him: and he has returned me brokenness for good.
changes.after: Now Dawid had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him: and he has returned me evil for good.

changes.before: Now therefore, my lord, as YHWH lives, and as your soul lives, seeing YHWH has withheld you from blood guiltiness, and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies, and those who seek brokenness to my lord, be as Nabal.
changes.after: Now therefore, my lord, as YHWH lives, and as your soul lives, seeing YHWH has withheld you from blood guiltiness, and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies, and those who seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

changes.before: Please forgive the trespass of your handmaid: for YHWH will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights the battles of YHWH; and brokenness shall not be found in you all your days.
changes.after: Please forgive the trespass of your handmaid: for YHWH will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights the battles of YHWH; and wrongdoing shall not be found in you all your days.

changes.before: When Dawid heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be YHWH, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from harm: and the brokenness-doing of Nabal has YHWH returned on his own head. Dawid sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to him as wife.
changes.after: When Dawid heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be YHWH, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from harm: and the wrongdoing of Nabal has YHWH returned on his own head. Dawid sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to him as wife.

changes.before: He said, Why does my lord pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what brokenness is in my hand?
changes.after: He said, Why does my lord pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what wrong is in my hand?

changes.before: Then Achish called Dawid, and said to him, As YHWH lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found brokenness in you since the day of your coming to me to this day: nevertheless the lords don't favor you.
changes.after: Then Achish called Dawid, and said to him, As YHWH lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found wrongdoing in you since the day of your coming to me to this day: nevertheless the lords don't favor you.

changes.before: I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May YHWH reward the one who acts from brokenness according to their wickedness."
changes.after: I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May YHWH reward the one who does wrong according to their wickedness."

changes.before: Why have you despised the word of YHWH, to do that which is brokenness in his sight? You have struck Uriyah the Hittite with the sword, and have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
changes.after: Why have you despised the word of YHWH, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriyah the Hittite with the sword, and have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

changes.before: This is what YHWH says: 'Behold, I will raise up brokenness against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes, and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
changes.after: This is what YHWH says: 'Behold, I will raise up harm against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes, and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

changes.before: Dawid said to all his servants who were with him at Yerushalayim, Arise, and let us flee; for else none of us shall escape from Avshalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us quickly, and bring down brokenness on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.
changes.after: Dawid said to all his servants who were with him at Yerushalayim, Arise, and let us flee; for else none of us shall escape from Avshalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us quickly, and bring disaster on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.

changes.before: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably to your servants; for I swear by YHWH, if you don't go forth, there will not stay a person with you this night: and that will be worse to you than all the brokenness that has happened to you from your youth until now.
changes.after: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably to your servants; for I swear by YHWH, if you don't go forth, there will not stay a person with you this night: and that will be worse to you than all the trouble that has happened to you from your youth until now.

changes.before: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and brokenness; for who is able to judge this your great people?
changes.after: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this your great people?

changes.before: If someone sin against their neighbor, and an oath be laid on him to cause him to swear, and they come [and] swear before your altar in this house;
changes.after: If someone sins against their neighbor, and an oath is laid on them to cause them to swear, and they come and swear before your altar in this house;

changes.before: and they shall answer, Because they forsook YHWH their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Mitzrayim, and laid hold on other gods, and worshiped them, and served them: therefore has YHWH brought all this brokenness on them.
changes.after: and they shall answer, Because they forsook YHWH their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Mitzrayim, and laid hold on other gods, and worshiped them, and served them: therefore has YHWH brought all this calamity on them.

changes.before: but have done brokenness above all who were before you, and have gone and made you other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back:
changes.after: but have done wrong above all who were before you, and have gone and made you other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back:

changes.before: Moreover by the prophet Yehu the son of Hanani came the word of YHWH against Baasha, and against his house, both because of all the brokenness that he did in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Yerovam, and because he struck him.
changes.after: Moreover by the prophet Yehu the son of Hanani came the word of YHWH against Baasha, and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Yerovam, and because he struck him.

changes.before: Achav said to Eliyahu, Have you found me, my enemy? He answered, I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is brokenness in the sight of YHWH.
changes.after: Achav said to Eliyahu, Have you found me, my enemy? He answered, I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is wrong in the sight of YHWH.

changes.before: See you how Achav humbles himself before me? because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the brokenness in his days; but in his son's days will I bring the brokenness on his house.
changes.after: See you how Achav humbles himself before me? because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the calamity in his days; but in his son's days will I bring the calamity on his house.

changes.before: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, there is yet one man by whom we may inquire of YHWH, Micaiah the son of Imlah: but I hate him; for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but brokenness. Yehoshafat said, "Don't let the king say so."
changes.after: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, there is yet one man by whom we may inquire of YHWH, Micaiah the son of Imlah: but I hate him; for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. Yehoshafat said, "Don't let the king say so."

changes.before: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but brokenness?
changes.after: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?

changes.before: Hazael said, Why weeps my lord? He answered, Because I know the brokenness that you will do to the children of Israel: their strongholds will you set on fire, and their young people will you kill with the sword, and will dash in pieces their little ones, and rip up their women with child.
changes.after: Hazael said, Why weeps my lord? He answered, Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel: their strongholds will you set on fire, and their young people will you kill with the sword, and will dash in pieces their little ones, and rip up their women with child.

changes.before: He made his son to pass through the fire, and practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he worked much brokenness in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.
changes.after: He made his son to pass through the fire, and practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he did much wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.

changes.before: But they didn't listen: and Menashe seduced them to do that which is brokenness more than did the nations whom YHWH destroyed before the children of Israel.
changes.after: But they didn't listen: and Menashe seduced them to do that which is evil more than did the nations whom YHWH destroyed before the children of Israel.

changes.before: therefore thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, Behold, I bring such brokenness on Yerushalayim and Yehudah, that whoever hears of it, both their ears shall tingle.
changes.after: therefore thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, Behold, I bring such calamity on Yerushalayim and Yehudah, that whoever hears of it, both their ears shall tingle.

changes.before: because they have done that which is brokenness in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Mitzrayim, even to this day.
changes.after: because they have done what is wrong in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Mitzrayim, even to this day.

changes.before: Therefore, behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the brokenness which I will bring on this place. They brought the king word again.
changes.after: Therefore, behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the calamity which I will bring on this place. They brought the king word again.

changes.before: He went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because it went brokenness with his house.
changes.after: He went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because trouble had come upon his house.

changes.before: If someone sin against their neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and they come and swears before your altar in this house;
changes.after: If someone sins against their neighbor, and an oath is laid on them to cause them to swear, and they come and swear before your altar in this house;

changes.before: They shall answer, Because they abandoned YHWH, the God of their fathers, who brought them forth out of the land of Mitzrayim, and laid hold on other gods, and worshiped them, and served them: therefore has he brought all this brokenness on them.
changes.after: They shall answer, Because they abandoned YHWH, the God of their fathers, who brought them forth out of the land of Mitzrayim, and laid hold on other gods, and worshiped them, and served them: therefore has he brought all this evil on them.

changes.before: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of YHWH: but I hate him; for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always brokenness: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. Yehoshafat said, Don't let the king say so.
changes.after: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of YHWH: but I hate him; for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. Yehoshafat said, Don't let the king say so.

changes.before: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but brokenness?
changes.after: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?

changes.before: If brokenness come on us, the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house, and before you, (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.
changes.after: If calamity comes on us—sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house, and before you, (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.

changes.before: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and practiced sorcery, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he worked much brokenness in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.
changes.after: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and practiced sorcery, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he did much wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.

changes.before: Menashe seduced Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, so that they did brokenness more than did the nations whom YHWH destroyed before the children of Israel.
changes.after: Menashe seduced Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, so that they did wrong more than did the nations whom YHWH destroyed before the children of Israel.

changes.before: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the brokenness that I will bring on this place, and on the inhabitants of it. They brought back word to the king.
changes.after: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the calamity that I will bring on this place, and on the inhabitants of it. They brought back word to the king.

changes.before: After all that is come on us for our broken deeds, and for our great guilt, seeing that you our God have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,
changes.after: After all that is come on us for our wrong deeds, and for our great guilt, seeing that you our God have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,

changes.before: Then said I to them, You see the brokenness case that we are in, how Yerushalayim lies waste, and the gates of it are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Yerushalayim, that we be no more a reproach.
changes.after: Then said I to them, You see the trouble that we are in, how Yerushalayim lies waste, and the gates of it are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Yerushalayim, that we be no more a reproach.

changes.before: But after they had rest, they did brokenness again before you; therefore left you them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried to you, you heard from heavens; and many times did you deliver them according to your mercies,
changes.after: But after they had rest, they did wrong again before you; therefore left you them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried to you, you heard from heavens; and many times did you deliver them according to your mercies,

changes.before: and I came to Yerushalayim, and understood the brokenness that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of Elohim.
changes.after: and I came to Yerushalayim, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of Elohim.

changes.before: Didn't your fathers do thus, and did not our God bring all this brokenness on us, and on this city? yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.
changes.after: Didn't your fathers do thus, and did not our God bring all this calamity on us, and on this city? yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.

changes.before: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great brokenness, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?
changes.after: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?

changes.before: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was brokenness determined against him by the king.
changes.after: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was harm determined against him by the king.

changes.before: For how can I endure to see the brokenness that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?"
changes.after: For how can I endure to see the harm that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?"

changes.before: But he said to her, "You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of Elohim, and shall we not receive brokenness?" In all this Job didn't sin with his lips.
changes.after: But he said to her, "You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of Elohim, and shall we not receive adversity?" In all this Job didn't sin with his lips.

changes.before: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this brokenness that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.
changes.after: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this adversity that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

changes.before: "If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
changes.after: "If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold themselves from speaking?

changes.before: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven there shall no brokenness touch you.
changes.after: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven there shall no harm touch you.

changes.before: "Behold, Elohim will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the people who act from brokenness.
changes.after: "Behold, Elohim will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the people who do wrong.

changes.before: the broken person writhes in pain all their days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
changes.after: the wicked person writhes in pain all their days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

changes.before: This is the portion of a broken person from Elohim, the heritage appointed to him by Elohim."
changes.after: This is the portion of a wicked person from Elohim, the heritage appointed to him by Elohim."

changes.before: that the brokenness a person is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led forth to the day of wrath?
changes.after: that the wicked person is reserved for the day of calamity, That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

changes.before: "This is the portion of a broken person with Elohim, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
changes.after: "This is the portion of a wicked person with Elohim, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

changes.before: When I looked for good, then brokenness came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.
changes.after: When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.

changes.before: "If I have rejoiced at the destruction of the one who hated me, or lifted up myself when brokenness found him;
changes.after: "If I have rejoiced at the destruction of the one who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him;

changes.before: There they cry, but none gives answer, because of the pride of brokenness men.
changes.after: There they cry, but none gives answer, because of the pride of wicked people.

changes.before: For you are not an Elohim who has pleasure in wickedness. Brokenness can't live with you.
changes.after: For you are not an Elohim who has pleasure in wickedness. evil can't live with you.

changes.before: if I have rewarded brokenness to the one who was at peace with me (yes, if I have delivered the one who without cause was my adversary),
changes.after: if I have rewarded evil to the one who was at peace with me (yes, if I have delivered the one who without cause was my adversary),

changes.before: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the brokenness man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
changes.after: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the wicked person, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

changes.before: The one who doesn't slander with their tongue, nor does brokenness to their friend, nor casts slurs against their fellow man;
changes.after: The one who doesn't slander with their tongue, nor does evil to their friend, nor casts slurs against their fellow man;

changes.before: For they intended brokenness against you. They plotted brokenness against you which cannot succeed.
changes.after: For they intended harm against you. They plotted harm against you which cannot succeed.

changes.before: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of people who act from brokenness have enclosed me. Like a lion, they pin my hands and feet.
changes.after: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of people who do wrong have enclosed me. Like a lion, they pin my hands and feet.

changes.before: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no brokenness, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
changes.after: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

changes.before: I hate the assembly of people who act from brokenness, and will not sit with the wicked.
changes.after: I hate the assembly of people who do wrong, and will not sit with the wicked.

changes.before: When people who act from brokenness came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
changes.after: When people who do wrong came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

changes.before: YHWH's face is against those who do brokenness, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.
changes.after: YHWH's face is against those who do wrong, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

changes.before: Brokenness shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
changes.after: evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

changes.before: They reward me brokenness for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
changes.after: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

changes.before: They plot iniquity on their bed. They set themselves in a way that is not good. They don't abhor brokenness.
changes.after: They plot iniquity on their bed. They set themselves in a way that is not good. They don't abhor evil.

changes.before: Don't fret because of people who act from brokenness, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
changes.after: Don't fret because of people who do wrong, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

changes.before: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret, it leads only to acting from brokenness.
changes.after: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret, it leads only to acting from evil.

changes.before: For people who act from brokenness shall be cut off, but those who wait for YHWH shall inherit the land.
changes.after: For people who do wrong shall be cut off, but those who wait for YHWH shall inherit the land.

changes.before: They shall not be disappointed in the time of brokenness. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
changes.after: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

changes.before: They who also render brokenness for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
changes.after: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

changes.before: Blessed is the one who considers the poor. YHWH will deliver them in the day of brokenness.
changes.after: Blessed is the one who considers the poor. YHWH will deliver them in the day of evil.

changes.before: Why should I fear in the days of brokenness, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
changes.after: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

changes.before: "You give your mouth to brokenness. Your tongue frames deceit.
changes.after: "You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

changes.before: Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is brokenness in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
changes.after: Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

changes.before: You love brokenness more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
changes.after: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

changes.before: YHWH will repay the brokenness to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
changes.after: YHWH will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

changes.before: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for brokenness.
changes.after: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

changes.before: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing brokenness;
changes.after: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing wrong;

changes.before: They encourage themselves in brokenness plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, "Who will see them?"
changes.after: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, "Who will see them?"

changes.before: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the brokenness that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
changes.after: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

changes.before: Elohim threw on them the fierceness of Elohim’s anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of brokenness.
changes.after: Elohim threw on them the fierceness of Elohim’s anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

changes.before: No enemy will tax him. No broken person will oppress him.
changes.after: No enemy will tax him. No wicked person will oppress him.

changes.before: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen brokenness.
changes.after: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

changes.before: no brokenness shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
changes.after: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

changes.before: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the people who act from brokenness flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
changes.after: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the people who do wrong flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

changes.before: For, behold, your enemies, YHWH, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the people who act from brokenness will be scattered.
changes.after: For, behold, your enemies, YHWH, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the people who do wrong will be scattered.

changes.before: They pour out arrogant words. All the people who act from brokenness boast.
changes.after: They pour out arrogant words. All the people who do wrong boast.

changes.before: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the people who act from brokenness?
changes.after: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the people who do wrong?

changes.before: You who love YHWH, hate brokenness. YHWH preserves the souls of YHWH’s saints. YHWH delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
changes.after: You who love YHWH, hate evil. YHWH preserves the souls of YHWH’s saints. YHWH delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

changes.before: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with brokenness.
changes.after: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

changes.before: They have rewarded me brokenness for good, and hatred for my love.
changes.after: They have repaid me harm for good, and hatred for my love.

changes.before: Set a broken person over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
changes.after: Set a wicked person over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

changes.before: They will not be afraid of brokenness news. Their heart is steadfast, trusting in YHWH.
changes.after: They will not be afraid of bad news. Their heart is steadfast, trusting in YHWH.

changes.before: Depart from me, you people who act from brokenness, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
changes.after: Depart from me, you people who do wrong, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

changes.before: YHWH will keep you from all brokenness. YHWH will keep your soul.
changes.after: YHWH will keep you from all harm. YHWH will keep your soul.

changes.before: For the scepter of wickedness won't remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won't use their hands to do brokenness.
changes.after: For the scepter of wickedness won't remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won't use their hands to do wrong.

changes.before: Deliver me, YHWH, from the brokenness man. Preserve me from the violent man;
changes.after: Deliver me, YHWH, from the wicked person. Preserve me from the violent man;

changes.before: YHWH, don't grant the desires of the wicked. Don't let their brokenness plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
changes.after: YHWH, don't grant the desires of the wicked. Don't let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

changes.before: A brokenness speaker won't be established in the earth. Brokenness will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
changes.after: A malicious speaker won't be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent person to overthrow them.

changes.before: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let them reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don't let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against broken deeds.
changes.after: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let them reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don't let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against wrong deeds.

changes.before: for their feet run to brokenness. They hurry to shed blood.
changes.after: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

changes.before: to deliver you from the way of brokenness, from the people who speak perverse things;
changes.after: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the people who speak perverse things;

changes.before: who rejoice to do brokenness, and delight in the perverseness of brokenness;
changes.after: who rejoice to do wrong, and delight in the perverseness of evil;

changes.before: Don't devise brokenness against your neighbor, seeing they dwell securely by you.
changes.after: Don't devise harm against your neighbor, seeing they dwell securely by you.

changes.before: Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of brokenness men.
changes.after: Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of wicked people.

changes.before: For they don't sleep, unless they do brokenness. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
changes.after: For they don't sleep, unless they do wrong. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

changes.before: The broken deeds of the wicked ensnare them. The cords of their sin hold them firmly.
changes.after: The wrong deeds of the wicked ensnare them. The cords of their sin hold them firmly.

changes.before: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises brokenness continually, who always sows discord.
changes.after: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises harm continually, who always sows discord.

changes.before: Reverence for YHWH is to hate brokenness. I hate pride, arrogance, the broken way, and the perverse mouth.
changes.after: Reverence for YHWH is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the wrong way, and the perverse mouth.

changes.before: The one who corrects a mocker invites insult. The one who reproves a broken person invites abuse.
changes.after: The one who corrects a mocker invites insult. The one who reproves a wicked person invites abuse.

changes.before: When a broken person dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
changes.after: When a wicked person dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

changes.before: The one who is truly righteous gets life. The one who pursues brokenness gets death.
changes.after: The one who is truly righteous gets life. The one who pursues evil gets death.

changes.before: Most certainly, the brokenness man will not be unpunished, but the seed of the righteous will be delivered.
changes.after: Most certainly, the wicked person will not be unpunished, but the seed of the righteous will be delivered.

changes.before: The one who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but the one who searches after brokenness, it shall come to them.
changes.after: The one who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but the one who searches after evil, it shall come to them.

changes.before: The wicked desires the plunder of brokenness men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
changes.after: The wicked desires the plunder of wicked people, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

changes.before: A brokenness a person is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
changes.after: A wicked person is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

changes.before: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot brokenness, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
changes.after: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot harm, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

changes.before: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with brokenness.
changes.after: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

changes.before: A righteous person hates lies, but a broken person brings shame and disgrace.
changes.after: A righteous person hates lies, but a wicked person brings shame and disgrace.

changes.before: A wise person fears, and shuns brokenness, but the fool is hotheaded and reckless.
changes.after: A wise person fears, and shuns evil, but the fool is hotheaded and reckless.

changes.before: The brokenness bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
changes.after: Those who do wrong bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

changes.before: Don't they go astray who plot brokenness? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
changes.after: Don't they go astray who plot harm? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

changes.before: YHWH's eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the brokenness and the good.
changes.after: YHWH's eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

changes.before: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out brokenness.
changes.after: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

changes.before: YHWH has made everything for its own end--yes, even the wicked for the day of brokenness.
changes.after: YHWH has made everything for its own end--yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

changes.before: One who winks their eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses their lips, is bent on brokenness.
changes.after: One who winks their eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses their lips, is bent on evil.

changes.before: An one who acts from brokenness heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
changes.after: One who does wrong heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

changes.before: A brokenness man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
changes.after: A wicked person seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

changes.before: Whoever rewards brokenness for good, brokenness shall not depart from their house.
changes.after: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from their house.

changes.before: A broken person receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
changes.after: A wicked person receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

changes.before: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all brokenness with his eyes.
changes.after: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

changes.before: Don't say, "I will pay back brokenness." Wait for YHWH, and YHWH will save you.
changes.after: Don't say, "I will pay back evil." Wait for YHWH, and YHWH will save you.

changes.before: Wounding blows cleanse away brokenness, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
changes.after: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

changes.before: The soul of the wicked desires brokenness; their neighbor finds no mercy in their eyes.
changes.after: The soul of the wicked desires evil; their neighbor finds no mercy in their eyes.

changes.before: A broken person hardens their face; but as for the upright, they establish their ways.
changes.after: A wicked person hardens their face; but as for the upright, they establish their ways.

changes.before: Don't be envious of brokenness men; neither desire to be with them:
changes.after: Don't be envious of wicked people; neither desire to be with them:

changes.before: One who plots to do brokenness will be called a schemer.
changes.after: One who plots to do wrong will be called a schemer.

changes.before: Don't lay in wait, broken person, against the habitation of the righteous. Don't destroy their resting place:
changes.after: Don't lay in wait, wicked person, against the habitation of the righteous. Don't destroy their resting place:

changes.before: Don't fret yourself because of people who act from brokenness; neither be envious of the wicked:
changes.after: Don't fret yourself because of people who do wrong; neither be envious of the wicked:

changes.before: for there will be no reward to the brokenness man; and the lamp of the wicked shall be snuffed out.
changes.after: for there will be no reward to the wicked person; and the lamp of the wicked shall be snuffed out.

changes.before: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors brokenness in his heart.
changes.after: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors deceit in his heart.

changes.before: Brokenness men don't understand justice; but those who seek YHWH understand it fully.
changes.after: People who do wrong don't understand justice; but those who seek YHWH understand it fully.

changes.before: A brokenness a person is snared by their sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
changes.after: A wicked person is snared by their sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

changes.before: "If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought brokenness, put your hand over your mouth.
changes.after: "If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have planned harm, put your hand over your mouth.

changes.before: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, a seed of people who act from brokenness, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken YHWH. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.
changes.after: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of people who do wrong, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken YHWH. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

changes.before: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me; new moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can't bear with brokenness assemblies.
changes.after: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me; new moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can't bear wrongdoing together with solemn assembly.

changes.before: Woe to those who call brokenness good, and good brokenness; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
changes.after: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

changes.before: Because Aram, Efrayim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted brokenness against you, saying,
changes.after: Because Aram, Efrayim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted harm against you, saying,

changes.before: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the brokenness, and choose the good.
changes.after: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

changes.before: For before the child knows to refuse the brokenness, and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
changes.after: For before the child knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

changes.before: Therefore YHWH will not rejoice over their young people, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an one who acts from brokenness, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
changes.after: Therefore YHWH will not rejoice over their young people, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and one who does wrong, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

changes.before: I will punish the world for their brokenness, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the haughtiness of the terrible.
changes.after: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the haughtiness of the terrible.

changes.before: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The seed of people who act from brokenness will not be named forever.
changes.after: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The seed of people who do wrong will not be named forever.

changes.before: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do brokenness are cut off--
changes.after: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do wrong are cut off--

changes.before: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the people who act from brokenness, and against the help of those who work iniquity.
changes.after: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the people who do wrong, and against the help of those who work iniquity.

changes.before: The ways of the scoundrel are brokenness. He devises wicked devices to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
changes.after: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked devices to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

changes.before: The one who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; The one who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with their hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops their ears from hearing of blood, and shuts their eyes from looking at brokenness--
changes.after: The one who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; The one who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with their hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops their ears from hearing of blood, and shuts their eyes from looking at evil--

changes.before: The one who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up an engraved image for him that will not be moved.
changes.after: The one who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. They seek a skilled artisan to set up an engraved image for them that will not be moved.

changes.before: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do brokenness, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.
changes.after: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do wrong, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

changes.before: Therefore shall brokenness come on you; you shall not know the dawning of it: and mischief shall fall on you; you shall not be able to put it away: and desolation shall come on you suddenly, which you don't know.
changes.after: Therefore shall calamity come on you; you shall not know the dawning of it: and mischief shall fall on you; you shall not be able to put it away: and desolation shall come on you suddenly, which you don't know.

changes.before: Blessed is the one who does this, and the child of humanity who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and keeps his hand from doing any brokenness.
changes.after: Blessed is the one who does this, and the child of humanity who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil.

changes.before: The righteous perishes, and no one lays it to heart; and merciful people are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the brokenness [to come].
changes.after: The righteous perishes, and no one lays it to heart; and merciful people are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the calamity [to come].

changes.before: Their feet run to brokenness, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.
changes.after: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.

changes.before: Then YHWH said to me, Out of the north brokenness shall break forth on all the inhabitants of the land.
changes.after: Then YHWH said to me, Out of the north evil shall break forth on all the inhabitants of the land.

changes.before: Israel [was] holiness to YHWH, the first fruits of his increase: all who devour him shall be held guilty; brokenness shall come on them, says YHWH.
changes.after: Israel [was] holiness to YHWH, the first fruits of his increase: all who devour him shall be held guilty; trouble shall come on them, says YHWH.

changes.before: For my people have committed two acts of brokenness: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
changes.after: For my people have committed two acts of evil: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

changes.before: Circumcise yourselves to YHWH, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you people of Yehudah and inhabitants of Yerushalayim; lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the brokenness of your doings.
changes.after: Circumcise yourselves to YHWH, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you people of Yehudah and inhabitants of Yerushalayim; lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the wrongdoing in your doings.

changes.before: Set up a standard toward Tzion: flee for safety, don't stay; for I will bring brokenness from the north, and a great destruction.
changes.after: Set up a standard toward Tzion: flee for safety, don't stay; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

changes.before: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes brokenness from the hills of Efrayim:
changes.after: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Efrayim:

changes.before: For my people are foolish, they don't know me; they are foolish children, and they have no understanding; they are wise to do brokenness, but to do good they have no knowledge.
changes.after: For my people are foolish, they don't know me; they are foolish children, and they have no understanding; they are wise to do wrong, but to do good they have no knowledge.

changes.before: They have denied YHWH, and said, It is not YHWH; neither shall brokenness come on us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
changes.after: They have denied YHWH, and said, It is not YHWH; neither shall evil come on us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

changes.before: Flee for safety, you children of Binyamin, out of the midst of Yerushalayim, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem; for brokenness looks forth from the north, and a great destruction.
changes.after: Flee for safety, you children of Binyamin, out of the midst of Yerushalayim, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem; for disaster looms from the north, and a great destruction.

changes.before: For the children of Yehudah have done that which is brokenness in my sight, says YHWH: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
changes.after: For the children of Yehudah have done what is wrong in my sight, says YHWH: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

changes.before: Death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this brokenness family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them, says YHWH of Armies.
changes.after: Death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this wicked family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them, says YHWH of Armies.

changes.before: They bend their tongue, [as it were] their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from harm to brokenness, and they don't know me, says YHWH.
changes.after: They bend their tongue, [as it were] their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from one wrong to another, and they don't know me, says YHWH.

changes.before: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don't speak: they must be carried, because they can't go. Don't be afraid of them; for they can't do brokenness, neither is it in them to do good."
changes.after: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don't speak: they must be carried, because they can't go. Don't be afraid of them; for they can't do wrong, neither is it in them to do good."

changes.before: Everyone is become brutish [and is] without knowledge; every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
changes.after: Everyone is become brutish [and is] without knowledge; every goldsmith is disappointed by their engraved image; for their molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

changes.before: What has my beloved to do in my house, seeing she has worked lewdness [with] many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do brokenness, then you rejoice.
changes.after: What has my beloved to do in my house, seeing she has worked lewdness [with] many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do wrong, then you rejoice.

changes.before: For YHWH of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced brokenness against you, because of the brokenness of the house of Israel and of the house of Yehudah, which they have worked for themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.
changes.after: For YHWH of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced harm against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Yehudah, which they have worked for themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

changes.before: Thus says YHWH against all my brokenness neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Yehudah from among them.
changes.after: Thus says YHWH against all my hostile neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Yehudah from among them.

changes.before: This brokenness people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and are gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.
changes.after: This wicked people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and are gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.

changes.before: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do brokenness.
changes.after: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do wrong.

changes.before: YHWH said, Most certainly I will strengthen you for good; most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of brokenness and in the time of affliction.
changes.after: YHWH said, Most certainly I will strengthen you for good; most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

changes.before: It shall happen, when you shall show this people all these words, and they shall tell you, Why has YHWH pronounced all this great brokenness against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against YHWH our God?
changes.after: It shall happen, when you shall show this people all these words, and they shall tell you, Why has YHWH pronounced all this great harm against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against YHWH our God?

changes.before: and you have done brokenness more than your fathers; for, behold, you walk every one after the stubbornness of his broken heart, so that you don't listen to me:
changes.after: and you have done wrong more than your fathers; for, behold, you walk every one after the stubbornness of his broken heart, so that you don't listen to me:

changes.before: Don't be a terror to me: you are my refuge in the day of brokenness.
changes.after: Don't be a terror to me: you are my refuge in the day of evil.

changes.before: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but let not me be disappointed; let them be dismayed, but don't let me be dismayed; bring on them the day of brokenness, and destroy them with double destruction.
changes.after: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but let not me be disappointed; let them be dismayed, but don't let me be dismayed; bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

changes.before: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their brokenness, I will relent from the brokenness that I thought to do to them.
changes.after: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their evil, I will relent from the evil that I thought to do to them.

changes.before: if they do that which is brokenness in my sight, that they not obey my voice, then I will relent from the good, with which I said I would benefit them.
changes.after: if they do what is wrong in my sight, that they not obey my voice, then I will relent from the good, with which I said I would benefit them.

changes.before: Now therefore, speak to the people of Yehudah, and to the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, saying, Thus says YHWH: Behold, I frame brokenness against you, and devise a device against you: return you now everyone from their broken way, and amend your ways and your doings.
changes.after: Now therefore, speak to the people of Yehudah, and to the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, saying, Thus says YHWH: Behold, I frame harm against you, and devise a device against you: return you now everyone from their wrong way, and amend your ways and your doings.

changes.before: Shall brokenness be recompensed for good? for they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.
changes.after: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.

changes.before: Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the brokenness that I have pronounced against it; because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.
changes.after: Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the calamity that I have pronounced against it; because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.

changes.before: Sing to YHWH, praise you YHWH; for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of people who act from brokenness.
changes.after: Sing to YHWH, praise you YHWH; for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of people who do wrong.

changes.before: The one who remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but the one who goes out, and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, they shall live, and their life shall be to him for a prey.
changes.after: The one who remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but the one who goes out, and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, they shall live, and their life shall be to them for a prey.

changes.before: For I have set my face on this city for brokenness, and not for good, says YHWH: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall burn it with fire.
changes.after: For I have set my face on this city for calamity, and not for good, says YHWH: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he shall burn it with fire.

changes.before: House of Dawid, thus says YHWH, Execute justice in the morning, and deliver the one who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the brokenness of your doings.
changes.after: House of Dawid, thus says YHWH, Execute justice in the morning, and deliver the one who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of your wrongdoing.

changes.before: Therefore thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, against the shepherds who feed my people: You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them; behold, I will visit on you the brokenness of your doings, says YHWH.
changes.after: Therefore thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, against the shepherds who feed my people: You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them; behold, I will call you to account for your wrongdoing, says YHWH.

changes.before: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourns; the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. Their course is brokenness, and their might is not right;
changes.after: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourns; the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. Their course is wrong, and their might is not right;

changes.before: In the prophets of Yerushalayim also I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; and they strengthen the hands of people who act from brokenness, so that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them become to me as Sedom, and the inhabitants of it as Amora.
changes.after: In the prophets of Yerushalayim also I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; and they strengthen the hands of people who do wrong, so that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them become to me as Sedom, and the inhabitants of it as Amora.

changes.before: They say continually to those who despise me, YHWH has said, You shall have peace; and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of their own heart they say, No brokenness shall come on you.
changes.after: They say continually to those who despise me, YHWH has said, You shall have peace; and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of their own heart they say, No trouble shall come on you.

changes.before: But if they had stood in my council, then had they caused my people to hear my words, and had turned them from their broken way, and from the brokenness of their doings.
changes.after: But if they had stood in my council, then had they caused my people to hear my words, and had turned them from their wrong way, and from the wrongdoing in their doings.

changes.before: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for brokenness; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I shall drive them.
changes.after: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for disaster; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I shall drive them.

changes.before: saying, Return you now everyone from their broken way, and from the brokenness of your doings, and dwell in the land that YHWH has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forevermore;
changes.after: saying, Return you now everyone from their wrong way, and from the wrongdoing in your doings, and dwell in the land that YHWH has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forevermore;

changes.before: For, behold, I begin to work brokenness at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says YHWH of Armies.
changes.after: For, behold, I begin to do wrong at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says YHWH of Armies.

changes.before: Thus says YHWH of Armies, Behold, brokenness shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great storm shall be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
changes.after: Thus says YHWH of Armies, Behold, disaster shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great storm shall be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

changes.before: It may be they will listen, and turn everyone from their broken way; that I may relent from the brokenness which I purpose to do to them because of the brokenness of their doings.
changes.after: It may be they will listen, and turn everyone from their wrong way; that I may relent from the calamity which I purpose to bring on them because of the wrongdoing in their doings.

changes.before: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of YHWH your God; and YHWH will relent from the brokenness that YHWH has pronounced against you.
changes.after: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of YHWH your God; and YHWH will relent from the calamity that YHWH has pronounced against you.

changes.before: Did Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah and all Yehudah put him to death? Didn't he revere YHWH, and entreat the favor of YHWH, and YHWH relented from the harm which YHWH had pronounced against them? Thus should we commit great brokenness against our own souls.
changes.after: Did Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah and all Yehudah put him to death? Didn't he revere YHWH, and entreat the favor of YHWH, and YHWH relented from the harm which YHWH had pronounced against them? Thus should we commit great harm against our own souls.

changes.before: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of brokenness, and of pestilence.
changes.after: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, calamity, and pestilence.

changes.before: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says YHWH, thoughts of peace, and not of brokenness, to give you hope in your latter end.
changes.after: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says YHWH, thoughts of peace, and not of harm, to give you hope in your latter end.

changes.before: and they came in, and possessed it, but they didn't obey your voice, neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do: therefore you have caused all this brokenness to come on them.
changes.after: and they came in, and possessed it, but they didn't obey your voice, neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do: therefore you have caused all this calamity to come on them.

changes.before: because of all the brokenness of the children of Israel and of the children of Yehudah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the people of Yehudah, and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.
changes.after: because of all the wrongdoing of the children of Israel and of the children of Yehudah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the people of Yehudah, and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.

changes.before: For thus says YHWH: Like as I have brought all this great brokenness on this people, so will I bring on them all the good that I have promised them.
changes.after: For thus says YHWH: Like as I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so will I bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

changes.before: therefore thus says YHWH, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Yehudah and on all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim all the brokenness that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.
changes.after: therefore thus says YHWH, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Yehudah and on all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim all the calamity that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.

changes.before: It may be that the house of Yehudah will hear all the brokenness which I purpose to do to them; that they may return everyone from their broken way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
changes.after: It may be that the house of Yehudah will hear all the calamity which I purpose to bring on them; that they may return everyone from their wrong way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

changes.before: I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring on them, and on the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and on the people of Yehudah, all the brokenness that I have pronounced against them, but they didn't listen.
changes.after: I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring on them, and on the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and on the people of Yehudah, all the calamity that I have pronounced against them, but they didn't listen.

changes.before: My lord the king, these men have done brokenness in all that they have done to Yirmeyahu the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.
changes.after: My lord the king, these men have done wrong in all that they have done to Yirmeyahu the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.

changes.before: Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring my words on this city for brokenness, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished before you in that day.
changes.after: Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring my words on this city for calamity, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished before you in that day.

changes.before: The captain of the guard took Yirmeyahu, and said to him, YHWH your God pronounced this brokenness on this place;
changes.after: The captain of the guard took Yirmeyahu, and said to him, YHWH your God pronounced this calamity on this place;

changes.before: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the brokenness that Yishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
changes.after: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the harm that Yishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

changes.before: Whether it be good, or whether it be brokenness, we will obey the voice of YHWH our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of YHWH our God.
changes.after: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of YHWH our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of YHWH our God.

changes.before: So shall it be with all the people who set their faces to go into Mitzrayim to sojourn there: they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; and none of them shall remain or escape from the brokenness that I will bring on them.
changes.after: So shall it be with all the people who set their faces to go into Mitzrayim to sojourn there: they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; and none of them shall remain or escape from the calamity that I will bring on them.

changes.before: Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: You have seen all the brokenness that I have brought on Yerushalayim, and on all the cities of Yehudah; and behold, this day they are a desolation, and no one dwells therein,
changes.after: Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Yerushalayim, and on all the cities of Yehudah; and behold, this day they are a desolation, and no one dwells therein,

changes.before: Therefore now thus says YHWH, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Why commit you [this] great brokenness against your own souls, to cut off from you man and woman, infant and suckling, out of the midst of Yehudah, to leave you none remaining;
changes.after: Therefore now thus says YHWH, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Why commit you [this] great harm against your own souls, to cut off from you man and woman, infant and suckling, out of the midst of Yehudah, to leave you none remaining;

changes.before: Therefore thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will set my face against you for brokenness, even to cut off all Yehudah.
changes.after: Therefore thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Yehudah.

changes.before: But we will certainly perform every word that is gone forth out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Yehudah, and in the streets of Yerushalayim; for then had we plenty of food, and were well, and saw no brokenness.
changes.after: But we will certainly perform every word that is gone forth out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Yehudah, and in the streets of Yerushalayim; for then had we plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

changes.before: so that YHWH could no longer bear, because of the brokenness of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed; therefore is your land become a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is this day.
changes.after: so that YHWH could no longer bear, because of the wrongdoing in your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed; therefore is your land become a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is this day.

changes.before: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against YHWH, and have not obeyed the voice of YHWH, nor walked in YHWH’s law, nor in YHWH’s statutes, nor in YHWH’s testimonies; therefore this brokenness is happened to you, as it is this day.
changes.after: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against YHWH, and have not obeyed the voice of YHWH, nor walked in YHWH’s law, nor in YHWH’s statutes, nor in YHWH’s testimonies; therefore this calamity has happened to you, as it is this day.

changes.before: Behold, I watch over them for brokenness, and not for good; and all the people of Yehudah who are in the land of Mitzrayim shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
changes.after: Behold, I watch over them for harm, and not for good; and all the people of Yehudah who are in the land of Mitzrayim shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

changes.before: This shall be the sign to you, says YHWH, that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely stand against you for brokenness:
changes.after: This shall be the sign to you, says YHWH, that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely stand against you for harm:

changes.before: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised brokenness against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. You also, Madmen, shall be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue you.
changes.after: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised harm against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. You also, Madmen, shall be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue you.

changes.before: Of Dammeseq. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard brokenness news, they are melted away: there is sorrow on the sea; it can't be quiet.
changes.after: Of Dammeseq. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard bad news, they are melted away: there is sorrow on the sea; it can't be quiet.

changes.before: Everyone is become brutish [and is] without knowledge; every goldsmith is disappointed by his image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
changes.after: Everyone is become brutish [and is] without knowledge; every goldsmith is disappointed by their image; for their molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

changes.before: I will render to Bavel and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their brokenness that they have done in Tzion in your sight, says YHWH.
changes.after: I will render to Bavel and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Tzion in your sight, says YHWH.

changes.before: Yirmeyahu wrote in a book all the brokenness that should come on Bavel, even all these words that are written concerning Bavel.
changes.after: Yirmeyahu wrote in a book all the calamity that should come on Bavel, even all these words that are written concerning Bavel.
