changes.before: and you shall say, Thus shall Bavel sink, and shall not rise again because of the brokenness that I will bring on her; and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Yirmeyahu.
changes.after: and you shall say, Thus shall Bavel sink, and shall not rise again because of the calamity that I will bring on her; and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Yirmeyahu.

changes.before: Doesn't brokenness and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
changes.after: Don't adversity and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

changes.before: When I tell the wicked, You shall surely die; and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same broken person shall die in their iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.
changes.after: When I tell the wicked, You shall surely die; and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked person shall die in their iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.

changes.before: when I shall send on them the brokenness arrows of famine, that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine on you, and will break your staff of bread;
changes.after: when I shall send on them the deadly arrows of famine, that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine on you, and will break your staff of bread;

changes.before: and I will send on you famine and brokenness animals, and they shall bereave you; and pestilence and blood shall pass through you; and I will bring the sword on you: I, YHWH, have spoken it.
changes.after: and I will send on you famine and dangerous animals, and they shall bereave you; and pestilence and blood shall pass through you; and I will bring the sword on you: I, YHWH, have spoken it.

changes.before: They shall know that I am YHWH: I have not said in vain that I would do this brokenness to them.
changes.after: They shall know that I am YHWH: I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.

changes.before: Thus says YHWH God: Smite with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas! because of all the brokenness abominations of the house of Israel; for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
changes.after: Thus says YHWH God: Smite with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas! because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

changes.before: Thus says YHWH God: A brokenness, an only brokenness; behold, it comes.
changes.after: Thus says YHWH God: A disaster, a singular disaster; behold, it comes.

changes.before: If I cause brokenness animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it, and it be made desolate, so that no one may pass through because of the animals;
changes.after: If I cause dangerous animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it, and it be made desolate, so that no one may pass through because of the animals;

changes.before: For thus says YHWH God: How much more when I send my four sore judgments on Yerushalayim, the sword, and the famine, and the brokenness animals, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and animal!
changes.after: For thus says YHWH God: How much more when I send my four sore judgments on Yerushalayim, the sword, and the famine, and the dangerous animals, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and animal!

changes.before: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be carried forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth to you, and you shall see their way and their doings; and you shall be comforted concerning the brokenness that I have brought on Yerushalayim, even concerning all that I have brought on it.
changes.after: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be carried forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth to you, and you shall see their way and their doings; and you shall be comforted concerning the calamity that I have brought on Yerushalayim, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

changes.before: But when the righteous turns away from their righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the broken person does, shall they live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done shall be remembered: in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them shall he die.
changes.after: But when the righteous turns away from their righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked person does, shall they live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done shall be remembered: in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them shall he die.

changes.before: Again, when the broken person turns away from their wickedness that they have committed, and does that which is lawful and right, they shall save their soul alive.
changes.after: Again, when the wicked person turns away from their wickedness that they have committed, and does that which is lawful and right, they shall save their soul alive.

changes.before: I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of brokenness men; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, YHWH, have spoken it.
changes.after: I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of wicked people; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, YHWH, have spoken it.

changes.before: When I tell the wicked, O broken person, you shall surely die, and you don't speak to warn the wicked from their way; that broken person shall die in their iniquity, but their blood will I require at your hand.
changes.after: When I tell the wicked, O wicked person, you shall surely die, and you don't speak to warn the wicked from their way; that wicked person shall die in their iniquity, but their blood will I require at your hand.

changes.before: I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause brokenness animals to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
changes.after: I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause dangerous animals to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

changes.before: Thus says YHWH God: It shall happen in that day, that things shall come into your mind, and you shall devise a brokenness device:
changes.after: Thus says YHWH God: It shall happen in that day, that things shall come into your mind, and you shall devise an evil plan:

changes.before: Therefore I make a decree, that every people, nation, and language, which speak anything brokenness against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill; because there is no other god who is able to deliver after this sort.
changes.after: Therefore I make a decree, that every people, nation, and language, which speak anything amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill; because there is no other god who is able to deliver after this sort.

changes.before: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great brokenness; for under the whole sky has not been done as has been done on Yerushalayim.
changes.after: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great calamity; for under the whole sky has not been done as has been done on Yerushalayim.

changes.before: As it is written in the law of Moshe, all this brokenness is come on us: yet have we not entreated the favor of YHWH our God, that we should turn from our iniquities, and have discernment in your truth.
changes.after: As it is written in the law of Moshe, all this calamity has come on us: yet have we not entreated the favor of YHWH our God, that we should turn from our iniquities, and have discernment in your truth.

changes.before: Therefore has YHWH watched over the brokenness, and brought it on us; for YHWH our God is righteous in all YHWH’s works which YHWH does, and we have not obeyed YHWH’s voice.
changes.after: Therefore has YHWH watched over the calamity, and brought it on us; for YHWH our God is righteous in all YHWH’s works which YHWH does, and we have not obeyed YHWH’s voice.

changes.before: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot brokenness against me.
changes.after: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot harm against me.

changes.before: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does brokenness happen to a city, and YHWH hasn't done it?
changes.after: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does calamity come to a city, and YHWH hasn't done it?

changes.before: Seek good, and not brokenness, that you may live; and so YHWH, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
changes.after: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so YHWH, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.

changes.before: Hate brokenness, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that YHWH, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Yosef."
changes.after: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that YHWH, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Yosef."

changes.before: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for brokenness, and not for good.
changes.after: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for harm, and not for good.

changes.before: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, 'Brokenness won't overtake nor meet us.'
changes.after: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, 'Disaster won't overtake nor meet us.'

changes.before: They all said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this brokenness is on us." So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Yonah.
changes.after: They all said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this trouble is on us." So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Yonah.

changes.before: Then they asked him, "Tell us, please, for whose cause this brokenness is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?"
changes.after: Then they asked him, "Tell us, please, for whose cause this trouble is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?"

changes.before: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because brokenness has come down from YHWH to the gate of Yerushalayim.
changes.after: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because trouble has come down from YHWH to the gate of Yerushalayim.

changes.before: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work brokenness on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
changes.after: Woe to those who devise iniquity and do wrong on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

changes.before: If someone walking in a spirit of falsehood lies: "I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink;" he would be the prophet of this people.
changes.after: "If someone walking in a spirit of falsehood lies: "I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink;" they would be the prophet of this people.

changes.before: You who hate the good, and love the brokenness; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
changes.after: You who hate the good, and love wrongdoing; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

changes.before: Then they will cry to YHWH, but YHWH will not answer them. Yes, YHWH will hide YHWH’s face from them at that time, because they made their deeds brokenness."
changes.after: Then they will cry to YHWH, but YHWH will not answer them. Yes, YHWH will hide YHWH’s face from them at that time, because their deeds were evil."

changes.before: Their hands are on that which is brokenness to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the broken desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.
changes.after: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the broken desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

changes.before: There is one gone forth out of you, who devises brokenness against YHWH, who counsels wickedness.
changes.after: There is one gone forth out of you, who devises harm against YHWH, who counsels wickedness.

changes.before: You who have purer eyes than to see brokenness, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the one who is more righteous than they,
changes.after: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the one who is more righteous than they,

changes.before: Woe to the one who gets a brokenness gain for their house, that they may set their nest on high, that they may be delivered from the hand of brokenness!
